panel.introduction: 81P/Wild 2 was visited by Stardust in 2004. This view contains only the observed terrain, about half the nucleus. Rotate it to see where the measured surface ends; no unseen hemisphere has been added.

facts.label: Terrain coverage
facts.value: About half the nucleus; observed regions only

facts.label: Source precision
facts.value: About 50 m horizontal resolution and 6 m vertical precision

moreFacts.label: Presentation
moreFacts.value: Only terrain visible and illuminated during the 2004 Stardust encounter is included, about half the nucleus. The unseen side and gaps remain open. Neutral gray is a model material, not observed albedo. Source plate ordering is made consistent without moving vertices. The archived model axes are retained at an arbitrary fixed phase; no current rotational orientation or spin is claimed.

moreFacts.label: Reference scale
moreFacts.value: 1.917 km equivalent radius of the published best-fitting ellipsoid (1.350 × 2.002 × 2.607 km semi-axes). This approximate scale does not supply terrain for the unseen side.
